competing_hypotheses.claim: Coinbase's XRP market is an important institutional price reference because Evernorth selected it as principal market for financial reporting.
supporting_evidence: SEC filing explicitly selects Coinbase as principal market under the company's volume, consistency and compliance criteria.
disconfirming_or_limiting_evidence: This is an accounting principal-market determination, not proof of exclusive trading, custody, market control or daily execution volume.
The determination is subject to annual reassessment.

competing_hypotheses.claim: New Evernorth financing will create additional XRP purchases.
supporting_evidence: $30M notes issued with stated intended use including XRP acquisition.
ELOC proceeds, if shares are sold, may be used for XRP and ecosystem activity.
disconfirming_or_limiting_evidence: No note-proceeds XRP purchase was verified.
ELOC draws are discretionary and no draw was verified.
ELOC proceeds are not cash until shares are sold.
The historical $214.05M XRP purchase occurred in 2025.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Evernorth's XRP treasury will become collateral supply for institutional or DeFi credit markets.
supporting_evidence: The prospectus says it may consider XRP-secured financing, lending to institutional counterparties and DeFi lending.
disconfirming_or_limiting_evidence: No executed XRP-secured financing transaction, counterparty, amount or onchain position is disclosed in the reviewed passages.
The filing says 100% XRP was in cold storage as of prospectus date.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Evernorth has already begun yield/DeFi activity after Closing.
supporting_evidence: The prospectus says yield strategies and DeFi protocol participation commenced following Closing.
disconfirming_or_limiting_evidence: The same prospectus says 100% of XRP was in cold storage as of prospectus date.
No specific protocol, wallet, amount, counterparty or transaction is identified in the reviewed passages.
The company says no material deployment was expected before Q4 2026.

red_team_objections: Coinbase being the accounting principal market does not make Coinbase the custodian; BitGo is named as primary custodian.
The $214.05M cash purchase and $388.91M in-kind contributions are different capital forms; do not call all 473M XRP cash purchases.
The $30M notes are actual financing proceeds but their use for XRP is not verified.
The ELOC is optional, not cash on hand; no draw is verified and the filing has a $76.8M versus $80.7M gross-proceeds inconsistency.
Do not claim XRP collateralization has occurred merely because the prospectus describes possible secured financing and DeFi lending.
Do not ignore the cold-storage versus yield/DeFi commencement disclosure tension.
Do not claim a 2-of-3 BitGo threshold from this SEC filing; it states multisignature and HSM controls without the exact threshold.
